name: Midtrans
line: Indonesian payment gateway with hosted checkout, links and local methods.

free.text: No subscription or Core API integration fee

cells.type: Payment gateway with aggregator and facilitator options
cells.countries: Indonesia focus; foreign businesses can apply
cells.payout: Bank withdrawal at least 3 business days after sale

fee.math: Foreign businesses can sign up, but it isn't published whether US sellers are eligible, and no US card rate is published.
Foreign businesses can sign up, but it isn't published whether UK sellers are eligible, and no UK card rate is published.
Foreign businesses can sign up, but it isn't published whether German sellers are eligible, and no German card rate is published.
Foreign businesses can sign up, but it isn't published whether Indian sellers are eligible, and no India card rate is published.
